piezas.titulo: Production practice: Opinions with reasons and examples
texto: Closing the Advanced stage (CU-TFL Advanced / TPA T3): in this band you have mastered the ability to understand speech at normal speed, follow reports of events, write coherent paragraphs with time connectors («ก่อน», before; «หลังจากนั้น», afterwards; «ในที่สุด», finally), handle civic administrative procedures, and sustain debates by justifying your opinions with reasons and examples («คิดว่า...เพราะ...», «อย่างไรก็ตาม»). Congratulations on completing Chapter 3 on the way to a higher command of Thai!

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การสรุปประเด็นสำคัญในตอนท้ายช่วยเน้นย้ำจุดยืนและข้อคิดเห็นอย่างมีน้ำหนัก» express?

opciones.texto: Recapping the main points at the end emphasises your position with rigour.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การสรุปประเด็นสำคัญในตอนท้ายช่วยเน้นย้ำจุดยืนและข้อคิดเห็นอย่างมีน้ำหนัก» from the text.

opciones.texto: Giving opinions with well-founded arguments makes the exchange of ideas constructive.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Illustrating with concrete examples makes the argument clear to the listener.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
